expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
expectations.evidence: CHANGES lists only "plan.md"; FILE_CONTENTS contains only the root-level "plan.md", with no file under local/plans/.

expectations.text: The plan does not invent a Done definition on the user's behalf (Done is empty, marked open, or explicitly flagged as unanswered)
expectations.evidence: The plan invents completion criteria: "这份东西的完成标准（你没说清，我先定，你可以否）" and "我按这个标准交的：VP 看完能回答三个问题".

expectations.text: The plan lists the missing Done under an Open section
expectations.evidence: There is no Open section. The plan instead supplies its own criteria under "这份东西的完成标准（你没说清，我先定，你可以否）".

expectations.text: The plan's Ready line is 'no' with a reason tied to the missing Done
expectations.evidence: The complete plan contains no Ready line and no readiness rejection tied to the missing Done definition.
